ranked_decisions.decision: The quarter's signal is the funding regime change: the raise ahead of need is the de facto FY27 capex guide (multi-year FCF deficit). Raise revenue estimates, not EPS.
Cloud acceleration is real (ex-TPU, record margin), but Q3 has a dated margin headwind from third-party capacity; the October margin decides whether capex returns hold.
Backlog net adds collapsed from >$200B to ~$50B, which threatens 2027 Cloud growth even with demand intact. Q3 net adds are the leading indicator.
Earnings quality: GAAP EPS is dominated by private marks (core roughly in line), and the OCF decline is a TPU inventory build that becomes structural if it repeats.

counterweights: Management on record: no further equity issuance planned (dilution tail bounded)
Operating margin +200bps y/y while capex nearly doubled
Part of the OCF drop is working-capital timing that can reverse
